Indicator 4a3 measures the proportion of patients with atrial fibrillation who receive anticoagulation treatment five years after their index date. The national standard for this indicator requires a minimum adherence rate of 90%. According to the 2024 report, the national average for [[danmark|Danmark]] stands at 87.3%, meaning the country as a whole fails to meet the target [^src1].

When examining the leaders and trailers across regions and health clusters, [[klynge-nord|Klynge NORD]] emerges as the clear leader, achieving a 94.1% adherence rate [^src1]. Other top performers include [[sundhedsklynge-sydvestjylland|Sundhedsklynge Sydvestjylland]] at 91.6%, [[goedstrupklyngen|Gødstrupklyngen]] at 91.5%, and the broader [[region-nordjylland|Region Nordjylland]] at 91.1% [^src1]. Conversely, the trailers are [[sundhedsklynge-bornholm|Sundhedsklynge Bornholm]] at 80.0%, [[sundhedsklynge-midt|Sundhedsklynge Midt]] at 83.0%, [[sundhedsklynge-byen|Sundhedsklynge Byen]] at 83.4%, [[aarhusklyngen|Aarhusklyngen]] at 83.8%, and [[region-hovedstaden|Region Hovedstaden]] at 84.3% [^src1].

Regarding the target of ≥ 90%, only four entities successfully met the standard in the tabular data: [[region-nordjylland|Region Nordjylland]], [[sundhedsklynge-sydvestjylland|Sundhedsklynge Sydvestjylland]], [[goedstrupklyngen|Gødstrupklyngen]], and [[klynge-nord|Klynge NORD]] [^src1]. Notably, the source document's summary text claims that "Klynge SYD" also met the standard, but the table itself lists [[sundhedsklynge-syd|Sundhedsklynge Syd]] at 87.1% with a "Nej" (No) fulfillment flag, indicating a discrepancy in the original report's summary [^src1]. All other regions and clusters, including the national aggregate, missed the target [^src1]. 

Because this comparison is derived from a single dated section in the 2024 report, no cross-sectional trend analysis can be performed across different report years, although the table itself references historical proportions for the 2017/18 and 2016/17 periods for internal reference [^src1]. Additional context, methodology, and related indicators across the 2023, 2024, and 2025 reporting periods are detailed throughout the respective AFDK publications [^src2][^src3][^src4][^src5][^src6][^src7][^src8][^src9][^src10][^src11][^src12][^src13][^src14][^src15][^src16][^src17][^src18][^src19][^src20][^src21][^src22][^src23][^src24][^src25][^src26][^src27][^src28][^src29][^src30][^src31].

An outlier in the data is [[sundhedsklynge-bornholm|Sundhedsklynge Bornholm]], which not only records the lowest adherence rate (80.0%) but also operates with a significantly smaller patient denominator (48 out of 60) compared to other clusters, resulting in a notably wide 95% confidence interval of 67.7% to 89.2% [^src1]. In contrast, [[klynge-nord|Klynge NORD]] is a positive outlier, breaking the 90% threshold with a high adherence rate of 94.1% and a tight confidence interval [^src1].
